title: Attention-gated polarity surprise direction V2
claim: During asset-specific social-attention shocks, lagged polarity surprise improves one-hour or four-hour outright return forecasts over market-only, polarity-only, and attention-state-only baselines; outside the shock state the model abstains.
mechanism: Abnormal attention identifies discrete public information arrival, while polarity relative to the asset's trailing social baseline supplies sign. Fragmented diffusion may leave a short-lived directional response even though unconditional fifteen-minute polarity failed.
target: One-hour and four-hour outright log returns for the registered ten-asset Binance USDT perpetual discovery panel, followed only after a gated freeze by a separately sealed Hyperliquid-target prospective confirmation.
horizon: 1h and 4h from an hourly UTC decision clock.
informationSet: Prior completed-hour Bluesky messages classified by the frozen sentiment model
Polarity surprise relative to the preceding 720 completed hours
Prior completed-hour attention shock relative to the preceding 720 completed hours
Point-in-time market returns, realized variance, calendar controls, and symbol effects
primaryBaseline: The strongest zero, historical-mean, market-only, polarity-only, or attention-state-only baseline.

evidence.summary: Registered a materially distinct polarity-only family after V1 disagreement coverage failed. No target-bearing row or outcome was read while writing this contract.
All four registered variants worsened forecast loss in every chronological fold. Positive-fold count was zero for every variant; no freeze or prospective activation was earned.

nextAction: Preserve this rejection. Do not tune polarity thresholds, horizons, estimators, or subgroups on the consumed period; return to a materially different information mechanism.
